metadata.description: Catalog of common API errors in SaaS/CRM environments (Salesforce, HubSpot, and generic REST APIs). Used by the diagnostic engine to match incoming errors to a known pattern.

errors.name: Bad Request - Data Validation Error
probable_causes: Missing required field(s) in the request payload
Invalid data type (e.g. a string sent where a number or date is expected)
Malformed JSON syntax in the request body
A field value violates a picklist/dropdown constraint (e.g. invalid status value)
Date format mismatch (e.g. MM/DD/YYYY sent instead of ISO 8601)
resolution_steps: Read the API's error response body carefully - it usually names the exact field that failed
Validate the payload against the endpoint's schema before sending it
Confirm the required fields for that object/record type in the provider's API documentation
Normalize date and number formats to what the API expects (usually ISO 8601 for dates)
Re-send the request with the corrected payload

errors.name: Unauthorized - Expired or Invalid Token
probable_causes: The access token has expired (OAuth 2.0 access tokens typically expire in 1-2 hours)
The token was revoked manually, or invalidated by a user password change
The refresh token has also expired or was revoked
The integration's credentials (Client ID / Client Secret) are incorrect
A sandbox token is being used against production, or vice versa
resolution_steps: Check the expiration timestamp of the current access token
Run the OAuth refresh token flow to obtain a new access token
If the refresh token has also failed, re-authenticate with the full OAuth flow
Confirm the integration's credentials have not been rotated or revoked in the admin panel
Verify the request is pointed at the correct environment (sandbox vs production)

errors.name: Forbidden - Insufficient Permissions
probable_causes: The API user/integration lacks permission for this object or action (e.g. a read-only user attempting a write)
The connected app's OAuth scopes do not include the required permission
IP restrictions on the org are blocking requests from this server's IP address
The integration user's profile or permission set was recently changed or revoked
Attempting to access a record outside the user's sharing rules (record-level security)
resolution_steps: Identify the exact permission required for the failing action (object CRUD + field-level security)
Review the integration user's profile / permission set (Salesforce) or the app's granted scopes (HubSpot)
Confirm the request's origin IP is allow-listed if IP restrictions are enabled
Escalate to a Salesforce/HubSpot administrator if a permission change is required
Re-authenticate if OAuth scopes were recently updated, since the existing token may need to be reissued

errors.name: Not Found - Record or Resource Missing
keywords: the requested resource does not exist
probable_causes: The referenced record ID no longer exists (it was deleted or merged into another record)
A typo or incorrect ID/URL in the request (wrong object API name or endpoint version)
The record exists in a different environment than the one being queried (sandbox vs production)
The record is not visible to the API user due to sharing rules (some APIs return 404 instead of 403 for hidden records)
resolution_steps: Confirm the record ID is correct and still exists in the target environment
Verify the endpoint URL and API version match the provider's current documentation
Check whether the record was recently deleted, merged, or archived
If sharing rules might be hiding the record, confirm with an admin whether it is actually a permissions issue
Confirm you are pointing at the correct environment (production vs sandbox/test account)

errors.name: Too Many Requests - Rate Limit Exceeded
probable_causes: The integration exceeded the API's request-per-second or request-per-day limit
A bulk sync or import job is firing requests without batching or throttling
Multiple integrations/processes sharing the same API credentials are competing for the same quota
No backoff strategy is implemented, so repeated immediate retries make the limit worse
resolution_steps: Read the Retry-After header (or the provider's equivalent) and wait the indicated amount of time
Implement exponential backoff with jitter for retries instead of immediate re-requests
Batch requests where the API supports bulk endpoints (e.g. Salesforce Bulk API, HubSpot batch endpoints)
Review current usage against the plan's limits and request a rate limit increase from the provider if justified
Add request throttling/queueing on the integration side to stay under the limit proactively

errors.name: Internal Server Error - Provider-Side Failure
probable_causes: Temporary issue on the provider's side (outage, deployment, degraded service)
An edge case in the request triggered an unhandled error server-side
Timeout on a very large or complex request
resolution_steps: Check the provider's public status page for ongoing incidents
Retry with exponential backoff, since 5xx errors are often transient
If the error persists, open a support ticket with the provider including the request ID and timestamp
Reduce payload size or complexity if the error correlates with large batch requests

errors.name: Sync Error - Duplicate Record Conflict
probable_causes: The same contact/lead was created independently in both systems before the sync connection existed
The matching field used for deduplication (usually email) has inconsistent formatting between systems (case, whitespace, aliases)
Deduplication rules are misconfigured or disabled in the sync tool
A record was merged in one system but the merge has not yet propagated to the other system
resolution_steps: Identify the matching/dedupe key configured in the sync tool (usually email) and confirm it is populated and normalized in both systems
Manually review and merge the duplicate records, keeping the one with more complete/authoritative data
Check the integration's sync logs for the specific duplicate/conflict error entries
Adjust the deduplication rules in the sync configuration to prevent recurrence
Re-run the sync for the affected records once the merge is complete

errors.name: Sync Error - Field Mapping Mismatch
probable_causes: A field was renamed or removed in one system (e.g. a custom Salesforce field), breaking the mapping in the sync tool
Data type mismatch between mapped fields (e.g. a HubSpot picklist value that has no matching Salesforce picklist option)
A required field on the destination system has no source field mapped, so the sync fails validation on write
Field-level permissions block the integration user from writing to a mapped field
resolution_steps: Open the sync tool's field mapping configuration and look for mappings flagged as broken or invalid
Confirm the field still exists in both systems with matching or compatible data types
Add any missing picklist/dropdown values on the destination side, or set a default value in the mapping
Verify the integration user has field-level write access to every mapped field
Re-sync the affected records once the mapping is fixed
